nodes.title: SG-2.3 · The Boy's Room asset folders and manifest referencing real files
nodes.body:
Context: game/ has a typed manifest schema (game/src/assets/manifest) but no game/public/assets tree and no manifest file. Desired behavior: worlds/the-boys-room/{backgrounds,furniture,objects,characters,effects,audio} and ui/{icons,frames,cursors} exist and hold real temporary pixel-art assets, and a manifest.json lists them and passes the existing validator. Expected result: every manifest path resolves to a file on disk. Why: future AI cycles can add or replace assets without touching the engine.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo, when the folders are listed, then all 6 world folders and 3 ui folders exist under game/public/assets and each holds at least one file
- Given the manifest.json, when parseManifest runs, then it returns ok with unique ids
- Given the manifest, when each asset path is resolved against game/public/assets, then every file exists


## Scope
- In scope: game/public/assets folder tree with temporary assets
- In scope: manifest.json for the-boys-room
- In scope: manifest file loader that checks files exist
- Out of scope: Phaser rendering
- Out of scope: frontend changes
- Out of scope: production-quality art
- Preserve: existing manifest zod schema API
- Preserve: existing content loader and tests
- Preserve: frontend/public/assets/bedroom.svg


## Technical constraints
- Manifest must satisfy manifestSchema in game/src/assets/manifest/schema.ts
- Assets are temporary and must be documented as such


## Definition of done
- All three requirements delivered and verified by unit tests


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Manifest loader reports missing asset files without throwing
nodes.body:
Context: parseManifest validates shape only, not that files exist. Desired behavior: loadManifestFile(manifestPath, assetsRoot) reads JSON, runs parseManifest, and for each asset checks the file exists under assetsRoot, returning {ok, data, errors} with path-named issues and never throwing on missing or malformed files. Expected result: dangling paths are reported clearly.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a manifest with all files present, when loaded, then ok is true
- Given an entry whose file is absent, when loaded, then ok is false with an issue naming assets.<i>.path
- Given a missing or malformed manifest file, when loaded, then ok is false and nothing throws


## Scope
- In scope: game/src/assets/loaders/manifestLoader.ts
- Out of scope: Phaser preload
- Preserve: parseManifest signature


## Technical constraints
- Reuse ManifestIssue and parseManifest
- node:fs only


## Definition of done
- Loader implemented


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Export loadManifestFile(manifestPath: string, assetsRoot: string): ParseResult<AssetManifest>. Wrap readFileSync and JSON.parse in try/catch returning {ok:false,errors:[{path:'manifest',message:`cannot read manifest: ${manifestPath}`}]}. Call parseManifest; if not ok return it. Then for each asset index i, if !existsSync(join(assetsRoot, asset.path)) push {path:`assets.${i}.path`, message:`missing asset file: ${asset.path}`}. Return {ok:false,errors} if any, else {ok:true,data}.
steps.code: import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { join } from 'node:path'; import { parseManifest, type ParseResult, type ManifestIssue, type AssetManifest } from '../manifest';
